propertyDescription: 44 spacious guest rooms (incl. 4 Family Suites with a smaller children's bedroom), plus a Presidential House/Suite for up to 12 guests.
notes: Rates inclusive of 16% VAT, 10% Service Charge, 2% Training Levy - but exclude park fees and a mandatory community levy of US$80 per person per night.
Non-Resident Contract (Sunworld) rate is roughly 23-24% below Non-Resident Rack (not a round percentage like other properties' STO tiers, e.g. Twin/Double Wilderness Green: 440/575=0.765).
All of the 'Suite' room categories are River Rooms; Wilderness Rooms and (non-suite) River Rooms are the two base categories, each further split Twin/Double vs Single/Standard.
